report:
Liver, segment 6, resection

Received in formalin is a partial hepatectomy specimen (segment 6) measuring 110 x 80 x 55 mm and weighing 210 g. There is a single tumour measuring 45 x 40 x 38 mm. The tumour is well circumscribed, tan-green and encapsulated, 8 mm from the parenchymal margin. Representative sections are taken; see block key.

(1-4) Tumour.
(5) Tumour with nearest parenchymal margin.
(6) Background liver.

Specimen and tumour
- Procedure: Partial hepatectomy, minor (less than 3 segments)
- Tumour site: Segment 6
- Tumour focality: Solitary
- Tumour size: 4.5 cm (largest tumour, greatest dimension)

Microscopic findings
- Histologic type: Hepatocellular carcinoma
- Histologic grade: G3: Poorly differentiated
- Tumour histology:
  The tumour is a poorly differentiated hepatocellular carcinoma. The tumour cells show marked nuclear pleomorphism and grow in solid sheets, with only focal hepatocellular differentiation.
- Tumour extension: Tumour confined to liver
- Satellitosis: Not identified
- Vascular invasion: Present, small vessel invasion (largest nodule)
- Perineural invasion: Not identified
- Treatment effect: No known presurgical therapy

Margins
- Parenchymal margin: Uninvolved by invasive carcinoma, 8 mm

Lymph nodes
- Regional lymph nodes: None submitted (0 examined)

Distant metastasis
- Distant metastasis: Not applicable

Pathological stage (AJCC 8th edition)
- pTNM: pT2 pNX

Additional findings
- Cirrhosis (Ishak stage 6/6)
- Chronic hepatitis (hepatitis B)

LIVER, segment 6, resection
- Poorly differentiated HEPATOCELLULAR CARCINOMA
- Stage pT2 (pTNM, AJCC 8th edition)
- Margin clear
- CHRONIC HEPATITIS B with CIRRHOSIS (Ishak stage 6/6)
